Callout.Name: Fall - Elderly Resident
Callout.Message: Elderly person fallen at home, cannot get up.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, hip pain, neighbour has the key.

Script.Line: I went down in the hallway and I have been here since.
The key is under the plant pot. The neighbour will show you.
Do not lift me by the arms. Please do not lift me by the arms.

Callout.Patient: I cannot put any weight on it. Where is the ambulance?

Lines.Approach: They have been on the floor since this morning and the neighbour has the key.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
